items.description: PS4 ELF engine. Project-confirmed firmware range 9.00–12.52; requires a compatible elfldr listening on 9021. The ELF is not a BIN payload.
items.preparation: Start the compatible PS4 elfldr and explicitly send the Orbis ELF to port 9021. Then open the patch manager on console port 23900; use /data/user/patches/xml_orbis for CUSA XML files.

items.name: PS5 PS Patch System loader
items.compatibility: PS5 ELF engine. Project-confirmed firmware range 3.00–12.70; requires a compatible elfldr on 9021. This does not establish support for 13.xx.
items.description: PS5 ELF engine. Project-confirmed firmware range 3.00–12.70; requires a compatible elfldr on 9021. This does not establish support for 13.xx.
items.preparation: Load the Prospero ELF through your compatible PS5 ELF loader, then open the patch manager on port 23900. CUSA XMLs use /data/user/patches/xml_orbis; native PPSA XMLs use /data/user/patches/xml_prospero.

items.name: PS4 Cheats Manager 1.2.2
items.compatibility: PS4 console PKG for managing cheats, patches and plugins. Install in your existing compatible homebrew environment; patch application additionally needs the matching GoldHEN plugin engine.
items.description: PS4 console PKG for managing cheats, patches and plugins. Install in your existing compatible homebrew environment; patch application additionally needs the matching GoldHEN plugin engine.
items.preparation: Install the PKG with your supported PS4 package installer. Open PS4 Cheats Manager to enable only the patch matching your exact title ID and game update, then fully restart the game.

items.name: GoldHEN Plugins 1.188 original ZIP
items.compatibility: PS4 GoldHEN 2.3 or newer on a firmware supported by that GoldHEN release. Original plugin release archive; extract it before selecting a PRX.
items.description: PS4 GoldHEN 2.3 or newer on a firmware supported by that GoldHEN release. Original plugin release archive; extract it before selecting a PRX.
items.preparation: The selected game_patch.prx is also provided directly. Preserve existing plugins.ini entries; configure the game-patch plugin for your title ID instead of loading every plugin.

archiveSafety.proof: ZIP central and local headers; raw and Unicode paths; Unix file-type/DOS device and reparse attributes; explicit extra-field allowlist

items.name: GoldHEN game_patch.prx 1.188
items.compatibility: PS4 GoldHEN 2.3 or newer, on a firmware supported by that release. Native PRX plugin; not an ELF payload and not a PS5 plugin.
items.description: PS4 GoldHEN 2.3 or newer, on a firmware supported by that release. Native PRX plugin; not an ELF payload and not a PS5 plugin.
items.preparation: Place game_patch.prx in /data/GoldHEN/plugins/, merge its line into the matching CUSA title section of /data/GoldHEN/plugins.ini, enable plugin loading in GoldHEN and select the exact XML option in PS4 Cheats Manager. Preserve existing plugin configuration.

EmulatorPack.zip is a separate dependency for emulator launch features.

items.name: PS MTP Explorer · PS4
items.compatibility: PS4 with GoldHEN active; publisher tested firmware 9.00, 10.01 and 11.00. Android access requires an unlocked MTP-capable phone and data cable. iPhone access is unsupported.
items.description: Browse an MTP Android phone, mounted USB storage and writable internal folders with the PS4 controller. Supports copying folders and reviewing PKG installation.
items.preparation: Install the publisher PKG through GoldHEN Package Installer. Connect an unlocked Android phone by a USB data cable and select File Transfer/MTP. Launch PS MTP Explorer on PS4, select a real device or writable /data destination, then use Options > New Folder or Copy/Paste. For a PKG, press X and review Install. Phone installs need temporary-package plus installed-content space.

items.preparation: Install the PS4 PKG with your supported package installer, launch Switchfin from the console home screen and enter your Jellyfin server details. Use media and server access you control. No Nintendo Switch or desktop files are needed for this PS4 package.

items.name: wiliwili · PS4

items.preparation: Install wiliwili-PS4.pkg with the PS4 package installer and launch its home-screen icon. Configure the app and sign in only if needed. Follow the PS4 software-decoding notes in the publisher README; Nintendo Switch and desktop setup steps do not apply.
